body.title: Create issues at first draft in a repo with no team policy when the tracker is on
body.summary: Widen ensureDraftIssues: a repo whose policy is none or not teamMode checks the tracker with resolveGithubConfig and, when it is on, ensures the Epic and Story issues through createGithubTracker (the pair the terminal approve uses); tracker type none stays not-applicable and makes no call; a malformed github.json is not-ready with its reason; a ToolDenied is rethrown; a team repo keeps loadTracker and today's behaviour. Update the draft-issues tests that pin not-applicable for any repo with no team policy.
acceptanceChecks: a solo repo with the tracker on gets its Epic and Story issues at first draft
tracker type none makes no tracker call and a malformed config is not-ready
the terminal approve over issues the daemon already created creates nothing and no duplicate
a team repo behaves as before
